plainTranslation: Their caution or criticism affects how freely you present yourself.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their caution or criticism affects how freely you present yourself. You may over-prepare, and feel watched. Show up as yourself; their approval isn't the bar.
